**Why:** This gives Low Tide a cinematic, scroll-driven three-scene introduction using only drawn SVG/CSS geometry. The Gallery Dark palette fits a music subject, and the requested thin progress bar is included. Semantic HTML, keyboard access, and reduced-motion fallback remain because they keep the page usable.

## Prompt
```text
GOAL: Create a cinematic scrolling music website for the jazz trio Low Tide. The visitor should understand the subject and remember Low Tide at the final scene. One index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, no libraries; a Google Fonts link is allowed.
CONTENT: Scene 1: “Low Tide”. Scene 2: “jazz trio”. Scene 3: “Low Tide”. Add no other visible words or facts.
SCENES: Track 450vh. All percentages are of the whole track, from one progress value.
Motif: no media files. Draw one recognisable unified SVG motif of exactly three broad, curved tidal bands arranged as a low horizontal swell: (a) three overlapping wave masses filling at least one third of the stage; (b) each band has a distinct rounded crest and one small asymmetric notch, with the three crests offset left, centre and right; (c) each band has a lighter inner highlight in a second tone. Keep the motif visible through all three scenes.
Draw it with care as one inline SVG: closed, filled, curved paths in at least three distinct palette hex tones (main body, lighter highlight, accent detail - bound to CSS variables inheriting each section/scene's theme, never a hardcoded dark fill) with a tight viewBox. No stick lines and no bare circles or rectangles standing in for the object. Whenever a scene or inverted band turns dark, update those CSS variables so dark SVG fills switch to light hex tones and every part stays clear across every scene.
Scene 1 | 0-33% | motif left, centre 50%/50% of its area, whole motif at scale 1, rotation 0deg, dark field | whole motif scale 1 -> 1.08 and translateY 0 -> 2% at 26-40%, the three bands settle into alignment, field remains dark | text hold 0-26, out 26-32
Scene 2 | 33-67% | motif right, centre 55%/50% of its area, close-up at scale 2 on the middle crest, rotated 8deg, field inverted | whole motif scale 1 -> 2 toward its middle crest and rotate 0 -> 8deg at 26-40%, the three bands tighten toward the centre, field swaps at 32-34% | text in 34-40, hold 40-60, out 60-66
Scene 3 | 67-100% | centred closing lockup, whole motif at scale 1.05, rotation 0deg, dark field | motif scale 2 -> 1.05 and rotate 8 -> 0deg at 60-74%, the three bands open from the close arrangement into a wider settled composition | text in 68-74, hold 74-100
MOTION:
p = clamp(-track.getBoundingClientRect().top / (track.offsetHeight - stage.offsetHeight), 0, 1). One track, one position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh stage, no ancestor with overflow hidden.
Smooth with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Every value is a pure function of drawn, so scrolling back reverses it.
Animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) inside each range. Never prevent or replace native scroll.
Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%. Outgoing text is at opacity 0 before incoming text appears. The motif stays visible through every hand-over.
LOOK: Ground #11100F, text #F1ECE4, accent #D6A45C; the inverted field uses ground #F1ECE4 and text #11100F, with accent reserved for motif shapes only. Use Cormorant Garamond with Georgia fallback for display and Manrope with Arial fallback for body. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene is display type and must fit inside its container with at least 24px margin, never below 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the stage and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, single motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner `.copy`/`.mask` elements stay at opacity 1; at p = 0 the stage starts in Scene 1's opening ground, and when Scene 2 inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited root/stage CSS variables at every breakpoint with at least 4.5:1 contrast. Never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries. Line height 1.05 for display, 1.5 for body, mask padding 0.1em.
LAYOUT:
The motif lives in one persistent stage-bound centred box (overflow hidden; min-height 0; min-width 0; z-index 1) with overflow-x clip on the stage (never stack duplicate scene SVGs in the sticky stage). At scale 1 the whole silhouette fits inside that box (SVG max-width 85% and max-height 85%, width/height auto, aspect ratio preserved) so nothing clips below the fold at 0% or 100%; draw one unified single-SVG motif (never floating disconnected halves) and animate transform only on the inner graphic, never scale the box itself.
At 1440x900, before the last scene, place the motif box (width 60%, height 100%, overflow hidden) and the text column (width 40%, vertically centred) side by side in separate non-overlapping regions so the motif never bleeds behind text. Scene 1: motif left, text right. Scene 2: motif right, text left.
The last scene is a centred closing lockup, unlike the first: use a two-row grid or flex column of top 64% (minmax(0, 64%), overflow hidden) above bottom 36% (minmax(0, 36%)) at full width so the entire SVG motif stays inside the top 64% box and never shares space with or covers the closing name centred in the bottom 36%.
At 390x844 and 360x640 the box is top 0 to 45% of the stage in every scene and text sits between 52% and 94%, with 24px gutters, centred in the last scene. Text and motif never overlap, nothing is clipped, nothing scrolls sideways; shrink the display size until the longest line fits.
ASSETS: None: draw everything in SVG and CSS. No stock, generated or placeholder media.
Add a thin fixed scroll progress bar at the top edge, 2px high, using #D6A45C, with a transform scaleX value derived from drawn progress and transform-origin left.
FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order, every word visible at opacity 1, sticky stage/track hidden (display none) until active, compact auto-height static sections (no 100svh spacer above text) above the fold with zero overlap; and when the active stage class IS set, hide the static fallback container (display none) so static copy never shows behind or beneath the stage. Keep keyboard scene-jump links visually hidden until focused (`:focus-visible`) unless a top navbar was requested, so only the active scene copy is shown at rest. JavaScript adds the class that turns on the stage only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce, switches live when that changes, and removes it if setup throws.
Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Failed media shows the drawn still with the text intact; waiting over 300ms shows a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.
AVOID: stacked template sections while motion is active, card grids, glowing borders, neon, purple-blue gradients, pill badges, text on top of the motif, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, invented statistics, testimonials, logos, stock media, and decorative loading bars.
DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% on 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640 the screen matches SCENES, with no overlapping text, empty screen, sideways scroll or console error. Reduced motion and no JavaScript show every word. Tab shows each link in view. Reload at 50% draws the 50% state. Report each check as passed, failed or not run.
```
